title: IEEE 802.4-style token-bus station: serial frames with preamble, SD, FC, DA, SA, LEN, payload, CRC-16 and ED; token hold with up to four data frames inside a programmable window, token pass to the next station, claim_token contention, an 8-word TX FIFO and an 8-word RX FIFO

fields.desc: this station's bus address (DA of its tokens and data, SA of its frames)

words.name: TXF
words.desc: push one 32-bit word (the payload of one 4-byte data frame) onto the TX FIFO; a push to a full FIFO is dropped with EVT

words.name: NS
words.desc: [7:0] next station: DA of the token pass

words.name: CTRL
words.desc: [16:8] token holding window in clocks, [0] claim_en (claim the token after 300 idle clocks)

words.name: RXF
words.desc: RX FIFO head: received payload bytes packed big-endian, the last word zero-padded; the read pops it

irqs.name: EVT
irqs.desc: token acquired, or an error: bad CRC, bad ED or overlong frame received, TX FIFO overflow, RX FIFO overflow

notes: rx_bit (serial in, 1 bit per PCLK, idle 1; the station hears its own frames), tx_bit and tx_en pass through unchanged.
NS, DA and CTRL are write-only in the core and read back as 0. A write with PSTRB != 4'hF to a core word is dropped with PSLVERR.
